states.changed: A reader meets the chain from chip to model as five stations with 23 acts of public bodies on it, can recolour the marks by who acted, on what ground, whether a holder is named and whose territory, and can open each act to its quoted record.

A reader can now recolour the chain by what stood afterwards and by the size each record states, finds five more acts (Google refused and then allowed in Dublin, the Memphis turbine permit, Indonesia's three-week block of a chatbot, Italy's binding hallucination warning), and reads in each act what happened to it next.

A reader now meets one plain sentence on whose public acted and what lasted, a new section where every act is coded a second time by a reader blind to the first (agreement per field, six corrections marked on the acts: three stops are now delays, and a 2023 order is found to rest also on what a model outputs), the stops counted once per matter with their ages, the one step on AI's control found (an EU inquiry, not an act), and the floor area the voided Virginia rezonings had planned.
